Explanation:  
The Ground Truth Answer states that the songwriter was 12 years older than Chubby Checker when the song was written and recorded. The Predicted Answer says "approximately 13 years older." The difference is only 1 year, and the Predicted Answer uses approximate terms ("about," "approximately"), suggesting a very close estimate. The underlying fact—that the songwriter was a bit more than a decade older—is effectively conveyed, and the slight difference is not substantial enough to make the substance differ.

Decision: TRUE
